inherited_core_rust.meaning: The1707-pass all-target run belongs to90cbfd3. src/ and tests/ remain unchanged through this observer change; only the new probe tests were rerun for Rust. This is not a fresh complete all-target run.

restored_baseline_public_replay.scope: Saved source-bound decomposition under the original region contract. Rust regeneration also checks the constructor, proof seals and C behavior. SAT requires Rust replay and supplies no accepted certificate.

finite_event_export_identity.meaning: The clean current Rust exporter yields the exact eighteen raw pairs of the completed twelve-positive-pair TLC run. Event correspondence is bounded by that finite family and budgets0..6.

z3.relocation: Native executable matches the published checkpoint. Wrapper is re-created at the stable toolchain path; its file hash differs from the former run-scoped wrapper.

retention.incident: The first attempt added results to an old kept run. It reached513.8MiB and was pruned by the512MiB policy, deleting local cold archives and tools. Public Git checkpoints and their embedded artifacts remained.
retention.repair: Restored exact Clang package hashes and native Z3 hash, regenerated the baseline from Git in a temporary worktree, and reran all8reports with one current evaluator. The worktree was removed after its clean baseline run.
retention.layout: Tools live in target/toolchains; completed bounded evidence in target/checkpoints/load-observer-evaluation-v1; temporary output is disposable. All remain under the4GiB monitor.
retention.archive_integrity: Every archive member and compressed file was checked against SHA256/size manifests before raw directories were removed.

reproduction.build: python3 tools/dev.py cargo build --locked --bin nirvana --example evaluation_probe
reproduction.policies: Run each profile with ordinary output and with --loop-solver /path/to/pinned/z3. Use tools/dev.py run --keep for the two short comparisons, or preserve verified archives outside disposable runs before later runs.
reproduction.baseline: Build the a322645 baseline first in an isolated clean worktree and evaluate it with this current evaluator. Then rebuild the current collector into the same managed binary location; no executable copies are required.
reproduction.heldout_policy: Inspect cohort aggregates and artifact identities; held-out source, generated bodies and individual results remain uninspected.

open_coverage: Saved state replay checks the recorded concrete inputs and prefixes. It is separate from the strict Rust shape/occurrence proof and the earlier4full-word/RAM SMT examples.
Projection is exactly the checked private temporary set. Arbitrary-PC entry and all-original-register equivalence are separate contracts.
Eight fresh held-out profiles do not apply this fold; their C output and denominator are preserved.
The earlier bounded event model remains byte-identical; its inherited finite results do not prove this observer or optimizer universally.
next_decision: Measure stable register inputs to the strict load-consumer context, using independent source-definition checks and the same M0 observations, before broadening the optimizer.
